## L3 - Components: engine and worker

```mermaid
graph TB

  subgraph diagram ["Component View: Dirigent - Worker [1..*]"]

    11["S3-compatible storage<br/>[Software System]<br/>Buckets the storage blocks and storage sources read and write. AWS S3, RustFS, MinIO."]
    12["Kafka / RabbitMQ<br/>[Software System]<br/>Message brokers. Topics and queues the queues pack consumes from and publishes to."]
    13["Alert channels<br/>[Software System]<br/>SMTP, Slack and webhook receivers an alert rule delivers through."]
    14["HTTP APIs<br/>[Software System]<br/>Any HTTP service an http.request step reaches, or that calls an endpoint source."]
    4["dirigent-dhis2<br/>[Software System]<br/>Adapter pack (winterop-com/dirigent-dhis2): the dhis2 connection kind, DHIS2 formats, and blocks for jobs, imports, metadata, tracker and analytics."]
    5["dirigent-contrib<br/>[Software System]<br/>Block packs for outside systems (winterop-com/dirigent-contrib), one package per system."]

    subgraph 15 ["Dirigent"]

      subgraph 25 ["Worker [1..*]"]

        26["Wake-ups<br/>[Component]<br/>LISTEN on dirigent_work. A commit wakes idle claims instead of the next poll; a lost one costs the poll it replaced."]
        27["Claim<br/>[Component]<br/>One query: a queued attempt past available_at, or a waiting one past next_poll_at, by priority then fairness. FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, filtered by tags."]
        28["Executor<br/>[Component]<br/>Calls one block under a per-worker semaphore: execute, probe, fetch or poke. Commits a remote handle the moment it returns."]
        29["Readiness and run status<br/>[Component]<br/>The last statement of every outcome transaction: readies dependents, renders replies, derives the run's status."]
        30["Run creation<br/>[Component]<br/>Inserts a run, its items and attempt rows in one transaction, under the pipeline's lock. Shared by the API, the scheduler and sources."]
        31["Recovery and deadline sweeps<br/>[Component]<br/>Reclaims expired leases (waiting if a handle was committed, else queued), settles overdue deadlines, flags stuck runs, reaps dead workers."]
        32["Polled sources<br/>[Component]<br/>Leases each due storage or sensor source, polls it with no lock held, makes a run per input and stores the cursor."]
        33["Held sources<br/>[Component]<br/>Keeps kafka and rabbitmq consumers open under a lease. A message is acknowledged only after its run commits."]
        34["Alert dispatcher<br/>[Component]<br/>Claims queued notifications and delivers each through its channel, retried like an attempt."]
        35["Plugin host<br/>[Component]<br/>Discovers packs through pluginkit entry points at startup, then dispatches by block id."]
        36["Block contract<br/>[Component]<br/>dirigent-plugin: Operator, Sensor, source kinds, notifiers, storage backends, connection kinds and formats."]
        37["Built-in blocks<br/>[Component]<br/>dirigent-blocks: http, storage, execute, sql, jq, queues and parquet families, and the alert channels."]
        38["Storage facade<br/>[Component]<br/>Dispatches URIs by scheme. Keeps a small output inline and a large one as a URI."]
      end

      41[("Database<br/>[Container: PostgreSQL 17; SQLite under dg dev]<br/>Pipeline versions as JSONB documents; runs, items, attempts, leases and due times as indexed rows; logs; the worker registry.")]
      42[("Artifact storage<br/>[Container: file:// or s3:// (dirigent-storage-s3)]<br/>Step outputs too large to inline, and each run's scratch prefix. Never a worker-local path.")]
    end
```

## Flow - An ad hoc run

```mermaid
graph LR

  subgraph diagram ["Dynamic View: Dirigent"]

    subgraph 15 ["Dirigent"]

      17["API server<br/>[Container: FastAPI / Uvicorn (Python)]<br/>dg server. The REST API, the web UI bundle, SSE streams, and endpoint sources. Embeds the scheduler unless --no-scheduler."]
      25["Worker [1..*]<br/>[Container: asyncio (Python)]<br/>dg worker. Claims due attempts and calls blocks; polls and holds sources; sweeps leases and deadlines; delivers alerts. Routed by capability tags."]
      39["dg CLI<br/>[Container: Typer (Python)]<br/>Applies documents, starts and watches runs, and starts the server, worker and scheduler processes."]
      41[("Database<br/>[Container: PostgreSQL 17; SQLite under dg dev]<br/>Pipeline versions as JSONB documents; runs, items, attempts, leases and due times as indexed rows; logs; the worker registry.")]
      42[("Artifact storage<br/>[Container: file:// or s3:// (dirigent-storage-s3)]<br/>Step outputs too large to inline, and each run's scratch prefix. Never a worker-local path.")]
    end

    1["Pipeline author<br/>[Person]<br/>Writes pipeline documents in YAML or the builder, applies them, and starts and reads runs."]
    14["HTTP APIs<br/>[Software System]<br/>Any HTTP service an http.request step reaches, or that calls an endpoint source."]

    1-. "1. dg run CODE --watch" .->39
    39-. "2. POST /api/v1/pipelines/{code}/$run<br/>[HTTP/JSON (dirigent-client)]" .->17
    17-. "3. Insert run and attempt rows; NOTIFY dirigent_work on commit<br/>[SQL, JSONB]" .->41
    25-. "4. Wake and claim the queued attempt FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED<br/>[pg_notify]" .->41
    25-. "5. execute: submit the job, get a remote handle<br/>[HTTPS]" .->14
    25-. "6. Commit the handle; park as waiting with next_poll_at<br/>[pg_notify]" .->41
    25-. "7. probe when due, until terminal; then fetch<br/>[HTTPS]" .->14
    25-. "8. Write the output as an artifact<br/>[file:// or s3://]" .->42
    25-. "9. Settle, ready dependents, derive run status; NOTIFY dirigent_settled<br/>[pg_notify]" .->41
    39-. "10. GET the run's events (SSE) until it settles<br/>[HTTP/JSON (dirigent-client)]" .->17

  end
```

```mermaid
      17["API server<br/>[Container: FastAPI / Uvicorn (Python)]<br/>dg server. The REST API, the web UI bundle, SSE streams, and endpoint sources. Embeds the scheduler unless --no-scheduler."]
```

## Flow - A polled source

```mermaid
graph LR

  subgraph diagram ["Dynamic View: Dirigent"]

    subgraph 15 ["Dirigent"]

      25["Worker [1..*]<br/>[Container: asyncio (Python)]<br/>dg worker. Claims due attempts and calls blocks; polls and holds sources; sweeps leases and deadlines; delivers alerts. Routed by capability tags."]

    25-. "2. List the prefix; objects not in the cursor are new<br/>[S3 API]" .->11
    25-. "3. Under the pipeline lock: one run per object, store the cursor, next poll one cadence later<br/>[pg_notify]" .->41
    25-. "4. Any worker claims the new runs' attempts<br/>[pg_notify]" .->41

  end
```
